content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
My neighbors read my thoughts when I pass them in the hall.
I can’t confirm mind reading. What specific behaviors did you observe—phrases, gestures, timing?
They look up exactly when I think about them.
Looking up is ambiguous. If you vary your walking time and route, does their behavior track your new schedule?
Try a couple of unannounced time shifts and note reactions. If reactions persist regardless of your timing, that challenges a thought-reading link.
That adds a control. If reactions are the same while you can’t hear them, general movement may explain it.
I’ll test both and log it.
